# Your Name Is on the Label—Do You Own It? — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-pga-06009
Voiceover: A commercial name can identify the business presented to buyers while the image itself preserves a different maker attribution.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Popular Graphic Arts Collection, Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division

Rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

### 8–16s — CO01-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · IDENTIFY — Which name is this?. Separate the person's legal name, professional name, signature, portrait, label name, house name, monogram, product line, domain, and social handle. Similar public presentation does not make these one legal object.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO01-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · LOCATE — Where is control recorded?. For a U.S. federal mark, inspect the registration and any recorded assignments; for the company, inspect governing records; for domains and accounts, inspect registrant and administrator access; for licenses and approvals, inspect executed agreements. Never substitute the label display for the record.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO01-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · DISTINGUISH — What power does each record confer?. Registration, ownership, licensed use, consent, approval, corporate voting, employment authority, account administration, and archive access answer different questions. A founder can possess some and not others.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO01-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · ESCALATE — What cannot this audit decide?. Common-law rights, state publicity law, foreign law, contractual interpretation, beneficial ownership, validity, priority, and disputed facts require jurisdiction-specific investigation and qualified counsel. The map prepares that review; it does not replace it.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S32
Voiceover: Fashion, Beauty, and Intellectual Property: Trademarks is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: United States Patent and Trademark Office

Rights: Government page may be cited; do not assume event media or graphics are public domain.
